content.title: The Singers | Filmfest
content.text: Skip to main content Tickets PURCHASE TICKETS Saturday, Nov. 1 at 10 a.m. SCAD Museum of Art Professional Shorts The Singers USA | 17 min. The Singers, a genre-bending film adaptation of a 19th-century short story written by Ivan Turgenev, follows a lowly pub full of downtrodden men who connect unexpectedly during an impromptu sing-off.Followed by the fiction feature Charliebird. A Q&A with director Sam Davis immediately follows the screening.Georgia premiere DIRECTOR Sam Davis PRODUCERS Jack Piatt David Breschel Charlie Cohen CAST Mike Young Chris Smither Will Harrington Judah Kelly DIRECTOR Sam Davis PRODUCERS Jack Piatt David Breschel Charlie Cohen CAST Mike Young Chris Smither Will Harrington Judah Kelly ABOUT THE DIRECTOR Sam Davis is an Academy Award-nominated multihyphenate filmmaker with a foundation in cinematography. He produced, shot, and edited the 2019 Academy Award-winning Netflix short Period. End of Sentence. and produced and shot the Oscar-nominated Disney+ short Nǎi Nai & Wài Pó. Davis has also directed six short films.
